name: Country Road
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Mulcahy's (Wantagh) - concerts and dance parties. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: A Long Island-area modern country cover show (Mulcahy's Wantagh, The Paramount Huntington, Daryl's House Club Pawling per ticket sites). No official website or social page found; the venue pages give no band links. Ticket resellers mix it up with other acts: 'Country Roads' (UK-style country classics production, facebook.com/CountryRoadsShow), 'Country Roads' John Denver tribute (Minneapolis, Dennis Curley), and The Country Roads Band featuring Kat Perkins (Minnesota). None of those are recorded. Bandsintown artist page https://www.bandsintown.com/a/429516-country-road may list socials; worth a manual look.
description: Live country cover show that plays today's country radio hits and older favorites, from Luke Combs, Morgan Wallen and Chris Stapleton to Shania Twain, Garth Brooks and Dolly Parton.

evidence.note: Mulcahy's (Wantagh) event page: Country Road on Fri Oct 16, 2026, 8 PM, 18+; a full-band show of current and classic country hits (Luke Combs, Morgan Wallen, Zach Bryan, Chris Stapleton, Shania Twain, Garth Brooks and more).
The Paramount (Huntington) hosted 'Country Road, With Special Guest: DJ Rumer' on Jul 10, 2026, billed as 'performing all your favorite country hits'.
Bandsintown lists the Mulcahy's show under an artist page 'COUNTRY ROAD' (artist id 429516); the artist page itself was blocked to our crawler.
